pages.title: File:Ourapteryx yerburii ssp. specimens and male genitalia.jpg

ObjectName.value: Ourapteryx yerburii ssp. specimens and male genitalia

Categories.value: Geometridae of Taiwan|Self-published work|Lepidoptera on black background|Lepidoptera of the Natural History Museum, London|Quality photo composites and montages|Geometridae of Nepal|Photographs taken on 2023-02-10|Featured pictures by Tiouraren|Featured montages|Focus stacking images of Lepidoptera|Geometridae genitalia|Ourapteryx yerburii specimens|Focus stacked image|Dorsal views of Lepidoptera specimen

ImageDescription.value:
Overview of the two known subspecies of geometrid moth Ourapteryx yerburii: yerburii and virescens, with mounted male specimens and genitalia (aedeagi displayed seperately) are shown. As described by Inoue, the facies and sizes of these two subspecies are almost identical, except that the furca in the male genitalia of virescens "is not so acutely downcurved nor dilated"[1].

The abdomen of yerburii was removed to extract the genitalia inside.

  • Ourapteryx yerburii yerburii (Butler, 1886)
    • Mounted specimen/Genitalia slide: NHMUK 015106199
      • Locality: Godawari at 1600 m, Lalitpur, Nepal
      • Collected: 8.v.1991, leg. H. Inoue [
        井上寛
        ].
      • Genitalia slide prepared by H. Inoue (slide no. 15076)
  • Ourapteryx yerburii virescens (Matsumura, 1910)
    • Mounted specimen: NHMUK 015106200
      • Locality: Erge-shan Trail at 523 m, Shiding, New Taipei City, Taiwan
      • Collected: 16.v.2007, leg. G. Martin & D. L. J. Quicke.
    • Genitalia slide: NHMUK 015106197
      • Locality: Lalashan, New Taipei City, Taiwan
      • Collected: 26-28.vi.1979, leg. H. Inoue.
      • Prepared by H. Inoue (slide no. 10322)

main.content:
=={{int:filedesc}}==
{{Information
|description={{en|1=Overview of the two known subspecies of geometrid moth ''Ourapteryx yerburii'': ''yerburii'' and ''virescens'', with mounted male specimens and genitalia (aedeagi displayed seperately) are shown. As described by Inoue, the facies and sizes of these two subspecies are almost identical, except that the furca in the male genitalia of ''virescens'' "is not so acutely downcurved nor dilated"<ref name="Inoue">{{ cite journal | author = Inoue, H. | title = On ''nivea''-group of ''Ourapteryx'' Leach and on the systematic status of ''O. yerburii'' Butler from Pakistan, with description of a new species from Korea (Geometridae, Ennominae) | journal = Tyô to Ga | volume = 44 | issue = 3 | pages = 107-116 | year = 1993 | issn = 0024-0974 | doi = 10.18984/lepid.44.3_107 }}</ref>.

The abdomen of ''yerburii'' was removed to extract the genitalia inside.

* '''''Ourapteryx yerburii yerburii'' (Butler, 1886)'''
** Mounted specimen/Genitalia slide: NHMUK 015106199
*** Locality: Godawari at 1600 m, Lalitpur, Nepal
*** Collected: 8.v.1991, leg. H. Inoue [{{lang|ja|井上寛}}].
*** Genitalia slide prepared by H. Inoue (slide no. 15076)

* '''''Ourapteryx yerburii virescens'' (Matsumura, 1910)'''
** Mounted specimen: NHMUK 015106200
*** Locality: Erge-shan Trail at 523 m, Shiding, New Taipei City, Taiwan
*** Collected: 16.v.2007, leg. G. Martin & D. L. J. Quicke.
** Genitalia slide: NHMUK 015106197
*** Locality: Lalashan, New Taipei City, Taiwan
*** Collected: 26-28.vi.1979, leg. H. Inoue.
*** Prepared by H. Inoue (slide no. 10322)}}
{{zh-tw|1=淡黃雙斑尾尺蛾已知的兩個亞種——指名亞種（''Ourapteryx yerburii yerburii''）與臺灣亞種（''O. y. virescens''）的雄蛾標本與生殖器切片，收藏於倫敦自然史博物館。兩亞種的外觀與體型幾無差異，惟臺灣亞種雄蛾生殖器的叉狀器（furca）不如指名亞種鼓脹，下彎幅度也較小<ref name = "Inoue"/>。}}
{{uk|1=Встановлені зразки та слайди геніталій самця метелика {{wu|п'ядуни}}, підвиду ''Ourapteryx yerburii'', що зберігаються в {{wu|Музей природознавства (Лондон)|музеї природознавства}}, {{wu|Лондон}}. Приклад репродуктивної ізоляції, два зовні ідентичних підвиди відрізняються лише однією структурою, відомою як фурка в чоловічих статевих органах.}}
